answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 21614 Country: India Title: I have reverted to islam, al hamdu lillah. I want to legally change my religion to islam but want to keep my original name. Can i do so? Whats the process for it? Question: I have reverted to islam, al hamdu lillah. I want to legally change my religion to islam but want to keep my original name. Can i do so? Whats the process for it? Answer ID: 21614 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 653/497/D=1431) Thank Almighty Allah Who gifted you the wealth of Islam, and try fully to practice the obligations of Iman and Islamic rulings. Choose any Islamic name for you i.e. Talha, Zubair etc and let people call and know you by this name. As far as for the changes in official documents are concerned, consult any Muslim expert advocate, if needed you can suffix your surname Pankaj with your new name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
